# Carousel

Move through a bounded or wrapping sequence of slides with direct controls.

## Usage

### Wrapping

Move from the last slide back to the first and from the first to the last.

<ComponentExample component="carousel" scenario="wrapping" title="Wrapping" description="Move from the last slide back to the first and from the first to the last." :index="0" />

### Bounded

Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum.

<ComponentExample component="carousel" scenario="bounded" title="Bounded" description="Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum." :index="1" />

### Paused

Pause automatic carousel movement while keeping manual navigation available.

<ComponentExample component="carousel" scenario="paused" title="Paused" description="Pause automatic carousel movement while keeping manual navigation available." :index="2" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="carousel" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="3" />

## Show the current slide

Slides and indicators expose the same `data-state="active|inactive"`, so current position can be styled without duplicating carousel state in presentation-only data.

```css
[data-scope='carousel'][data-part='indicator'] {
  opacity: .35;
}

[data-scope='carousel'][data-part='indicator'][data-state='active'] {
  opacity: 1;
  background: currentColor;
}
```

## API reference

See [Carousel API](/api/components/carousel) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

Slides, navigation controls, pause control, and indicators remain individually named and operable.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/carousel/) for the host accessibility contract.
